title: When a conversation needs a summary — built

steps.path: A conversation after the assistant summarizes older messages
steps.headline: After a summary, only the older messages dim; the recent messages the assistant still sees stay bright.
steps.changed: Today everything above the Compacted divider dims, including the recent messages kept alongside the summary. Now the dimming stops at the first kept message.
steps.notice: The last exchange or two before the divider stay at full contrast, so you can tell what the assistant still remembers word for word.
steps.risk: If the app can't tell where the kept part starts, it dims nothing new rather than guess. Claude Code chats and Clear are unchanged.

steps.path: Status bar model chip, then choose a model this chat is too long for
steps.headline: Choosing a model the chat no longer fits now asks first instead of switching.
steps.changed: A small window says the chat is too long for the new model and offers Summarize and switch. X or Esc closes it and keeps your current model; the list stays open.
steps.notice: Models the chat fits still switch instantly, with no popup. Summarize and switch uses the current model to write the summary, then switches.
steps.risk: The fit check is an estimate from this chat's size; a model whose size the app doesn't know is never blocked.

steps.surface: Model picker on a narrow window
steps.path: The same choice at phone width
steps.headline: At phone width the question, the button and the X all fit on screen.
steps.changed: Same popup as on desktop, sized to the narrow window. Closing it returns you to the model list with your current model still selected.
steps.notice: Nothing about your chat or model changes unless you press Summarize and switch and it succeeds.

steps.headline: While summarizing, the button waits and says closing stops it; a failure says why and that your model didn't change.
steps.changed: Left: the button reads Summarizing… and a line says it can take a minute and that closing stops it. Right: an honest error, ending with which model you are still using.
steps.notice: The chat also shows its usual Compacting card while the summary runs, and the Compacted divider when it lands.
steps.risk: A slow local model can take minutes here; the popup stays until it finishes or you close it.
